cases.problem:
At the Gooddog Obedience School, dogs can learn to do three tricks: sit, stay, and roll over. Of the dogs at the school: \begin{tabular}{l@{\qquad}l}
50 dogs can sit & 17 dogs can sit and stay \\
29 dogs can stay & 12 dogs can stay and roll over \\
34 dogs can roll over & 18 dogs can sit and roll over \\
9 dogs can do all three & 9 dogs can do none
\end{tabular} How many dogs are in the school?
cases.rationale: First 400 tokens identify inclusion-exclusion and define sets; later checking is not all labeled necessary.

cases.problem: Melinda has three empty boxes and $12$ textbooks, three of which are mathematics textbooks. One box will hold any three of her textbooks, one will hold any four of her textbooks, and one will hold any five of her textbooks. If Melinda packs her textbooks into these boxes in random order, the probability that all three mathematics textbooks end up in the same box can be written as $\frac{m}{n}$, where $m$ and $n$ are relatively prime positive integers. Find $m+n$.
cases.rationale: Trajectory corrects counting that omitted allocation of remaining books, but contains local mistakes and redundant checking. Abstain from binary necessary-correction label.
cases.purpose: Existing exposed calibration engineering diagnosis; not training, screening or independent confirmation

selection: Four earliest third-copy hits before3500, then four smallest training IDs with no64-token third-copy hits and >=2000 thought tokens. Score-blind qualitative review; not random sample.
annotation_limits: Assistant qualitative labels, not independent human gold labels. Labels do not use probe scores. Necessary-correction specificity remains unestablished.
interpretation: Stop on numerical mismatch. Keep no-boundary loops separate. Observable-loop misses or productive-span triggers argue against current probe; no posthoc threshold/layer search. Passing only motivates RC14-domain checking.
